Cc: Horizon Audit Team <audits@hd-audit.com>

Subject: Request: post-report addendum/bridge endorsement to cover controls gap

Hi David,

Thanks again for sending the SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2027-06-30. Our procurement and security teams reviewed the report and flagged a post-report period gap between the report end date (2027-06-30) and our go-live target on 2027-08-01. To complete our vendor onboarding we need a short bridge/addendum letter that: (1) affirms there were no material control changes in the post-report period to date, or (2) discloses identified changes and the mitigation plan.

Could you provide a draft bridge letter (1 page preferred) plus a checklist of evidence we can reference (SOC 2 report sections, KMS/HSM attestations, change logs, exception tickets, and any interim monitoring reports)? Our timeline is tight — do you think you can share a draft by 2027-07-27 so we can route to our InfoSec by 2027-07-29?

Also, please confirm who on your side will sign the endorsement (VP Compliance or equivalent) and whether you can include an attestation of continuous monitoring since 2027-07-01.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that’s easier.

Best,
Sara Lopez
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Horizon Health

[Attachment: Horizon SOC 2 intake checklist (pdf)]

Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: post-report addendum/bridge endorsement to cover controls gap

Thanks — I put together a draft and a short evidence checklist. High level:

1) Report period: confirmed — SOC 2 Type II report covers controls testing through 2027-06-30.

2) Proposed bridge language (draft doc attached):
- Option A (affirmation): "To the best of our knowledge, there have been no material changes to the design or operation of the controls described in the referenced SOC 2 Type II report between 2027-07-01 and the date of this letter."
- Option B (disclosure + mitigation): "The following operational changes occurred... and the following mitigations were deployed..."

We should prefer Option A with a short qualification clause rather than an absolute warranty — Legal prefers "to the best of our knowledge" and to avoid timelines that imply re-testing.

3) Available supporting evidence (we can share):
- SOC 2 report (attached)
- KMS key-rotation record excerpt (redacted)
- Change-control summary (for prod infra) covering 2027-07-01 to present
- Recent infra monitoring dashboard export (last 30 days)
- Incident/exception log summary (redacted)

4) Signatory: We can have VP Compliance sign. If Horizon requires C-level, Legal asks we route to Chief Risk Officer. VP Compliance signatory is standard and quicker.

5) Timeline: I can circulate the draft to Legal & Security today. If Legal is comfortable we can send to Horizon by 2027-07-25 EOD. I attached the draft bridge-addendum-docx and a redacted evidence checklist.

Can you confirm: (a) are we ok with Option A + qualification, and (b) do we want to include a short line about automatic fallback to the full SOC2 report for substantive questions?

-Marissa
Sr. Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: bridge-addendum-draft.docx]
